review: The primary reader inspected the whole sheet, both halves, and seventeen broad and focused crops at 3–8×. Every line, the four composition equations, the counit domain as actually written, the bracketed right note, the interlinear sigma, both diagrams and their accompanying text were read. There is no H text. The right note runs horizontally, so no rotation was needed. The unusual counit formula and final/initial-object language are transcribed without mathematical alteration.
